slides.texte_overlay:
The 5 theories that actually
change your life

1. The Next Step Theory

You don't need the whole plan.
You need the next step.
Clarity shows up after you move,
not before.

2. The Broken Window Theory

One messy corner invites more mess.
Fix the small things in your space
and the big things follow.

3. The Compound Curiosity Theory

Every new thing you learn makes
the next thing easier to learn.
Five minutes a day adds up fast.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. The Mirror Theory

People usually treat you
the way you treat yourself.
Raise your own standard first.
